options.text: 8 rounds
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: 4 rounds (since $2^4 = 16$)
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the verified NCERT principle for Rounds for 16 Teams.

options.text: 5 rounds
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: 3 rounds
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT principles for Yoga and Yogic Practices (Rounds for 16 Teams):
4 rounds (since $2^4 = 16$)

Detailed Analysis:
Number of rounds equals the power of two: $16 = 2^4$, so there are 4 rounds.
Therefore, option (B) is the correct answer.

questionText:
Match the asthma-alleviating asana in List I with its anatomical posture in List II:

List I:
(A) Sukhasana
(B) Chakrasana
(C) Gomukhasana
(D) Parvatasana

List II:
(I) Simple cross-legged seated posture with erect spine and meditative breathing
(II) Supine full backward arch with palms and soles planted on the floor (Wheel Pose)
(III) Seated with knees stacked one above the other, clasping hands behind the back
(IV) Seated in Padmasana, raising interlocked palms straight upward toward the ceiling (Mountain Pose)

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.text: A-I, B-II, C-III, D-IV
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Correctly maps each entity across columns.

options.text: A-II, B-I, C-III, D-IV
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: A-IV, B-II, C-I, D-III
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: A-I, B-III, C-IV, D-II
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Sukhasana is cross-legged easy pose; Chakrasana is the wheel arch; Gomukhasana stacks knees and clasps hands; Parvatasana stretches arms upward.
Hence, Option D is correct.
Hence, option (A) is the correct match.
